text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, enalapril maleate 10 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 507 tablets (44.4 days at 11.4 tablets/day). Corvale General holds 262 tablets (18.8 days at 14 tablets/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include enalapril maleate as of 2026-10-21. A label for Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) shows a registered plant with a most recent VAI inspection ending 2026-07-16.

Our position: Current inventory covers near-term needs at both sites. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no identifiable plant. Supply commitments and plant inspection histories require verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current supply commitments with Amici Pharma, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer verifies current supply commitments with Bausch Health US LLC (needs: buyer approval).
3. Buyer verifies current supply commitments with Bausch Health US, LLC (needs: buyer approval).
4. Buyer verifies current supply commitments with Chartwell RX, LLC (needs: buyer approval).
5. Buyer verifies current supply commitments with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited (needs: buyer approval).
6. Buyer monitors Bryant Ranch Prepack plant inspection history for any change in classification (needs: buyer approval).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
